item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 7 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 7 #SLPRSD
Issued at 11:40 AM 30 August 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #OrientalMindoro and #Romblon within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #CamarinesSur(DelGallego, Ragay, Lupi), #CamarinesNorte(SanVicente, SanLorenzoRuiz and Basud) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.

item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 3 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 3 FINAL #SLPRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at 05:00 PM 29 August 2026

All RAINFALL WARNING over forecast areas are now terminated.

Moderate to occasionally heavy rains are expected over #CamarinesNorte(Paracale, Vinzons, SanVicente and Talisay) within the next 2 to 3 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #OrientalMindoro, #Marinduque, #Romblon, #Masbate(Balud, Milagros, Mandaon), #CamarinesNorte(SantaElena, Capalonga, Labo and JosePanganiban) which may persist within 2 to 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are still advised to MONITOR the weather condition.

item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 2 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 2 #SLPRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at 02:00 PM 29 August 2026

Yellow Warning: #OrientalMindoro
Associated Hazard: FLOODING in low lying areas and near river channels.

Meanwhile, Moderate to occasionally heavy rains are expected over #Romblon(Alcantara, Looc, SantaFe, Calatrava), #Masbate(Cawayan, Placer, PioV.Corpuz, Esperanza), #Catanduanes(Gigmoto, SanMiguel, Virac, Bato, Baras), #NorthernSamar(SanVicente, Capul and SanAntonio) within the next 2 to 3 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Romblon(Cajidiocan, Magdiwang, Odiongan, Romblon, SanAgustin, SanAndres, SanFernando, SanJose, Ferrol, SantaMaria), #Sorsogon, #CamarinesSur(Baao, Balatan, Bato, Bombon, Buhi, Bula, Calabanga, Camaligan, Canaman, Caramoan, Gainza, Garchitorena, Goa, IrigaCity, Lagonoy, Magarao, Milaor, Minalabac, Nabua, NagaCity, Ocampo, Pamplona, Pasacao, Pili, Presentacion, Sagñay, SanFernando, SanJose, Tigaon, Tinambac), #Albay, #Marinduque(Buenavista, Torrijos, Gasan), #Masbate(SanPascual, Claveria, Monreal, SanJacinto, SanFernando, Batuan, Aroroy, Baleno, Mandaon, Balud, Milagros, CityOfMasbate, Mobo, Uson, Dimasalang, Palanas, Cataingan), #Catanduanes(Pandan, Caramoran, Bagamanoc, Viga, SanAndres and Panganiban) which may persist within 2 to 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 05:00 PM Today.
